plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the full OrbitRide booking flow, including search, filtering, seat selection, passenger details, extras, payment, and confirmation, across both desktop and mobile viewports.
plan.summary: The exploration will follow the primary booking flow from landing page search through to final confirmation, validating each step's form inputs, interactive controls, and state transitions. It will then probe edge cases like validation errors, back-navigation, and filter combinations on the routes page. Finally, critical path interactions will be re-validated on a mobile viewport to assess responsiveness and tap-target sizing.
assumptions: The site uses client-side routing or static linking to transition between the HTML pages (index -> routes -> seats -> passengers -> extras -> payment -> confirmation).
The 'Sign in', 'Routes', and 'Help' links in the header are likely non-functional placeholders (href='#') but should be clicked to verify.
Form validation exists for required fields (FROM, TO, DATE) on the landing page and passenger details.
The SVG seat map on seats.html supports interactive selection based on the passenger count chosen in the initial search.
risk_hotspots: index.html: Small tap targets for header navigation links (Routes, Help, Sign in) on mobile.
routes.html: Filter interactions (price slider, amenities checkboxes) and their effect on the trip list; small tap targets for 'Select' buttons on mobile.
seats.html: SVG seat map interactivity, distinguishing between occupied/standard/priority states, and enforcing the selected passenger count limit.
payment.html: Form validation for credit card inputs and formatting.

phases.title: Landing Page & Search Initiation
phases.objective: Validate the search form, popular routes, and header navigation on the landing page.
key_checks: Verify autocomplete/datalist behavior for FROM and TO city inputs
Test passenger count selector (change to 2 passengers)
Select a future date in the DATE picker
Click 'Find rides' with empty fields to check validation
Click 'Popular routes' cards to verify they navigate to routes.html
Click header links (Routes, Help, Sign in) to check for dead ends
exit_criteria: Search form successfully submitted with valid data (e.g., Cedar Plains to Falconer, 2 passengers)
Validation behavior observed for empty inputs
Header links clicked and behavior recorded

phases.title: Route Selection & Filtering
phases.objective: Exercise the trip results, date carousel, and left-hand filters on the routes page.
key_checks: Interact with the 7-day date carousel at the top
Apply time-of-day filter (e.g., Morning)
Adjust the Max price slider and verify list updates
Toggle amenities checkboxes (Wi-Fi, Power outlet, Restroom, Express)
Observe 'seats left' warnings on specific trips
Click 'Select' on a trip to proceed to seat selection
exit_criteria: A specific trip selected, transitioning to seats.html

phases.title: Seat Selection & Checkout Steps
phases.objective: Complete the seat map interaction and advance through the remaining checkout forms.
key_checks: Select exactly 2 seats on the SVG bus map matching the passenger count
Attempt to select an occupied seat to verify it is disabled
Verify priority vs. standard seat visual states and price updates
Fill out passenger details form with validation checks
Add/remove extras on extras.html
Enter payment details and submit
exit_criteria: Correct number of seats selected and continued
Passenger and payment forms filled and submitted

phases.title: Confirmation & Post-Booking
phases.objective: Review the confirmation page and test any post-booking actions like 'Free refund up to 24h'.
key_checks: Verify booking details match the selections made in previous steps
Check for any action buttons (e.g., Cancel/Refund, Download Ticket)
Click the OrbitRide logo to return to home

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-run critical path interactions on a mobile viewport to identify responsive design issues.
key_checks: Check layout and tap-target sizes for header nav on index.html
Verify filter panel accessibility and layout on routes.html
Validate SVG seat map usability and touch interactions on seats.html
Ensure no horizontal overflow or clipped elements across pages

coverage_targets.pages: visit all 7 known HTML pages in the booking flow sequence
coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible filters, form inputs, SVG seat interactions, and navigation links
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat the search, route filtering, and seat selection flows on mobile viewport to verify layout warnings

notes: Prescan flagged small tap targets for header links and route 'Select' buttons; pay close attention to these during mobile testing.
Routes page showed 'null → null · null' in the header text, indicating potential state management issues if navigation occurs without proper search context; verify this behavior.
